senses.gloss: m. (preced.) name of a locust or a beetle (sack-carrier), supposed to be the cricket.
units: <cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 42:5">Sifré Deut. 42</cite> <he>מעלה ס׳</he> (some ed. <cite ref="O01443"><he>סַקָּאי</he></cite>) (the late rain) brings the cricket.—Pl. <he>סַקָּיִּין</he>, <he>סַקָּאִין</he>.
<cite ref="Taanit 6a">Taan. 6ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 863">Yalk. Deut. 863</cite>.
